question: What practices are required in this Shambhava realization beyond full I-consciousness?
premises: The realization explained here is the reflective awareness of full I-ness.
Other practices include mantra, mudra, ritual action, and worship.
None of those other practices are required here.
inference: In this mode, direct recognition of full I-consciousness stands apart from auxiliary ritual techniques.
plain_english: This is the reflective awareness of full I-ness that has been explained; here there are no other practices such as mantra, mudra, ritual action, or worship.
